topics.inflation: Inflation means prices generally increase over time, reducing the purchasing power of money.
topics.compounding: Compounding means returns can generate additional returns over time.
topics.saving: Saving means keeping money for future needs and emergencies.
topics.investing: Investing means putting money into assets with the possibility of growth and risk of loss.
topics.sip: SIP is a method of investing a fixed amount periodically in an investment product.
topics.mutual_fund: A mutual fund pools money from investors and invests according to its stated strategy.
topics.risk: Risk is the possibility that actual results may differ from expectations, including possible loss.
topics.diversification: Diversification means spreading money across different investments to reduce concentration risk.
topics.liquidity: Liquidity means how easily an asset can be converted into cash.
